confidence_notes: Low overall. Beer and cappuccino are the best-supported anchors, with several aggregator sources clustering near $2 to $2.50. Mid-range meal sources conflict widely (about $9 to $27 for two), so $20 is a bounded estimate close to the Pai figure in the Numbeo listing snippet. Cocktail and wine lack Pai-specific data: the menus retrieved were mainly Bangkok, Pattaya and resort lists, so cocktail is set at 2.4 times the beer anchor and wine at 3 times, with a tourist-town adjustment. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation pages or listings were searched or inspected. The FX figure is the 18 Nov 2026 RBA observation from rba.gov.au exchange-rate page content returned by search; the F11.1 daily table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pai is a small highland tourist town in northern Thailand, and no Pai-specific price for cocktails or wine was retrieved. Food and drink were benchmarked against Pai cost-of-living aggregator snippets and Thailand-wide and Chiang Mai/Bangkok comparisons, with a discount to Bangkok on local food and a tourist premium on Western-style meals. Accommodation is a holistic estimate drawn from the budget guesthouse and boutique resort market in comparable northern Thai tourist towns, not from any searched listing.
